label: Любящий
description: A 10-sentence card for любящий, the present active participle of любить.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Любящий comes from любить via the present stem of любят plus -щ- and an ending. It agrees with masculine отец and means the loving father.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets любящая agree with мать, marking the loving mother.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Любящее takes the neuter ending -ее to match сердце, describing the loving heart that forgives.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ие joins любящие to родители, picking out the loving parents who support you.
Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the animate object мужа the participle takes -его, so любящего agrees in gender, number and case as the husband who loves me.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Любящей carries the feminine genitive ending to agree with жены, marking whose care it is — the care of the loving wife.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative object деду pulls любящему into the dative -ему ending, naming the loving grandfather to whom I am grateful.

missions.phrase: Я живу с любящей бабушкой счастливо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental. After живу с the noun бабушкой stands in the instrumental, and любящей takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the loving grandmother.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о любящем брате тепло.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so брате and любящем both take prepositional endings as the loving brother we speak about.

Strategic focus: Plural nominative paraphrase. Любящие животных дети unfolds as дети, которые любят животных — children who love animals. The participle folds that который-clause into one agreeing word.
